title: Invasion of Trentino (1866)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Invasion of Trentino (1866)", at revision 1366259718, opens: "The Invasion of Trentino was a series of military operations undertaken by the Kingdom of Italy against the Austrian Empire during the Third Italian War of Independence of 1866, which was part of the larger Austro-Prussian War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3800873, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1866 military operation". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
